response.overview: From the golden hues that shine brightly at UST's main building, to the serenity of walking through the Benavides lane, come with us to see through Iris' lens. Communication is so much more than what meets the eye-the bigger question is, are you willing to listen, and do what you can? or will you stay in your comfort zone instead? but do remember as the saying goes. Growth rarely happens in your comfort zone.
